data.title: The Mirror Threat Update is Live
data.meta_title: The Mirror Threat Update is Live
data.content:
Freecon’s advance into the Wild Ten has reached a breaking point. Control is tightening, resistance is faltering, and every battle now carries greater weight. The Mirror Threat Battle Pass marks the beginning of the endgame—where only the most adaptable Pilots will endure.

Garuda War Robot

Meet Garuda, a fast, aggressive Flanker built for target isolation and disruption. Using its energy cage, it traps enemies in place—cutting off escape routes and creating openings for decisive strikes.

Garuda excels at hit-and-run tactics, thriving on timing and positioning rather than sustained frontline combat.

Now available in Daily Deals and through Direct Offers.

I.O.N. Weapon

A heavy energy cannon that fires a focused ionized beam, dealing high damage to armor while remaining less effective against shields.

Now available in Daily Deals and through Direct Offers.

Mirror Threat Battle Pass

​​​​​​

Running from April 14 to May 18, the Mirror Threat Battle Pass features Kumo Modules, Horde, Conflux and Skuld Titan weapons, and a wide selection of visual customizations inspired by the Wild Ten.

Progress through Shipments to unlock powerful equipment, rare resources, and distinctive cosmetics as you advance.

Choose your path:

  • Free Battle Pass — Progress and unlock select rewards without spending.
  • Battle Pass Gold (200 WarpReals) — Earn enough Tokens to claim every item across all shipments.

Salvage & Intel Discount Event (April 14–21)

Now’s the perfect time to upgrade. For one week, enjoy a massive 50% discount on Salvage upgrades, making it easier than ever to strengthen your builds.

This week, the Tortuga engineers invite Pilots to take a closer look at the following builds:

  • War Robot Modules: Bulwark, Crix, Ares
  • Weapons: Thunder, Stormpike, Scourge
  • Gear: Holofield, Nanite Repair, Fuel Burn, Minefield, Flashbang, Kinetic Pulse

Discord Emoji & Sticker Contest

Make your mark on the official Discord server!

Join our Discord, create custom emojis or stickers inspired by War Robots: Frontiers, and share them in the #emoji-sticker-contest channel for a chance to have your design featured in the game’s community spaces!

The Top 10 entries will have their designs added as emojis or stickers on our official Discord server, along with 50,000 Salvage, 10,000 Credits, and an exclusive Mirror Threat Discord role.

All valid participants will receive 15,000 Salvage.

Submissions are open from April 14 to April 28.

Face the Mirror Threat

From new machines to experimental weapons, this update is all about control and adaptation. Build smarter, strike faster, and dictate the fight—because in this phase of the war, momentum is everything.

Face the Mirror Threat, Pilots. Adapt fast. Strike first.

Download War Robots: Frontiers for free today:

PlayStation®5│PlayStation®4│ Xbox Series X|S │Xbox One

Steam │ MY.GAMES Launcher

Stay tuned to our official X, Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, and TikTok channels, and join the War Robots: Frontiers subreddit and Discord for all the latest news and updates.
